Title: General availability: Azure Synapse Link for existing MongoDB collections

Body.Content:
Now you can enable Azure Synapse Link on your existing MongoDB collections stored in Azure Cosmos DB for Mongo DB. Unblock near real time analytics at no RU/s cost. This capability is available to you through Azure CLI or PowerShell.

Learn more.
